name: Jämmer
tagline: Edit speech by its words. Repair, level and publish it.
summary: Jämmer is a native Mac audio editor for podcasts and other speech. Cut by deleting words in the transcript, repair hum, clicks and noise, find and level the speakers, and export at the right loudness with chapters. Everything runs on your Mac, it's free and open source, and AI agents can drive it too.

features.title: Edit the transcript, and the audio follows
features.text: Transcribe on your Mac, in Swedish with KB-Whisper or in 25 languages with Parakeet, then delete words, filler words and long pauses as text. The transcript always reads exactly what plays.

features.title: Restoration you can hear before you commit
features.text: Remove mains hum, repair clipping and clicks, and reduce noise with DeepFilterNet. Preview the repair against the original, and undo it any time: your files are never changed.

features.title: Draw on the spectrogram
features.text: Mark a cough, a click or a phone ringing by where it sits in time and pitch, with a box, a lasso or a brush, then heal it from the sound around it or turn it down.

features.title: Speakers found, levelled and cleaned
features.text: Find who speaks when, one person per track or several on one. Bring everyone to the same loudness, ride a speaker who drifts, and remove the other voices bleeding into each microphone.

features.title: Stems from a finished mix
features.text: Split a song into vocals, drums, bass and other, or a film mix into speech, music and effects, on your Mac. The stems add up to exactly the original, so nothing changes until you turn one down.

features.title: Loudness for where it's going
features.text: Presets for Apple Podcasts, Spotify, YouTube, EBU R 128 and ATSC A/85, measured to ITU-R BS.1770 and tested against the EBU signals. A true-peak limiter holds the peaks under the ceiling you set, with the balance between tracks kept. Export WAV, FLAC, AAC, MP3 and Opus with chapters from your markers.

features.title: An assistant that runs on your Mac
features.text: Ask in Swedish or English: "ta bort alla ehm och tystnader längre än en sekund". The assistant turns it into Jämmer's own commands, shows what a plan will remove before it runs, and everything is one undo step.

features.title: Works with Flimmer and Glimmer
features.text: Send a clip's sound from Flimmer, edit it here and press ⌘S: it's saved back into the same file and Flimmer picks it up. The three apps can also call each other's commands.

features.title: Agents can drive it
features.text: Copy one line from the splash into Claude or another agent. It reads the guide Jämmer serves on your Mac and can open, measure, edit, repair and export audio in your windows, one undoable step at a time.

features.title: A history that keeps every branch
features.text: Undo a few steps, try something else, and the steps you undid are still there. The history tree is saved with the project.

features.title: Your plugins, safely
features.text: Audio Unit effects on any track, with latency compensated. Other developers' plugins run in their own process, so a crash can't take your session with it.

features.title: Non-destructive and bit-exact
features.text: Edits play from your original files, and audio you haven't changed comes out exactly as it went in; Jämmer's tests check it sample by sample. Broadcast Wave data, iXML and markers survive.
